title: Loops
subtitle: Every Member of the Party
heading: ## Unit 6 ·

parts.scope: Lesson 5A "For Each, Yes?" (with 5A-remembers; all its exercises in order, including 5A-S solo), Lesson 5B "While the Clock Ticks" (with 5B-remembers), and Quiz 5
Project 5P "The Velocite Watch" (with its side quest), Extra practice 6X (5B-05), the optional Lesson 5C "Loops in One Line", and the optional Article 5-A1 "Looping Over a Dictionary"
Quick Check 5 (both forms qc5-a and qc5-b as testout items, plus their question forms as optional quiz items, the way Units 1-4 did) and the Loops cheatsheet

slips: missing colon or indentation on the for line; printing the list instead of the item (for member in members: print(members)); resetting the total INSIDE the loop; the final print indented inside the loop (prints every pass) or a filter print outside it; for i in 5 (TypeError: 'int' object is not iterable) vs range(5); using the item as an index (for hero in roster: roster[hero]); range(len(x)) neighbors going one past the end (wall[i + 1] IndexError) — the loop must stop one early; reading roster["name"] instead of member["name"]; a while loop with no update (runs forever) or the update outside the loop; while vs if; break in the wrong place; typing the values by hand instead of reading them from each item; copying the example list's name.
earlierNote: Units 1-2 are shipped (in this folder). Units 3 (Functions I) and 4 (Lists) are verified in staging and copied into this folder. Unit 5 (Dictionaries) is being written AT THE SAME TIME in another staging dir and is NOT in this folder; its concepts come from concept_map.json (prefixes u05a, u05b, u05c). Unit 6 may use dictionaries ONLY within those planned concepts (dict literals, reading/writing by key, nested reads, a list of dicts). Use the real party-table values and the real chalk-wall data 48, 48, 47, 46, 44, 41, 37.
verifyNote: Fix every Unit 6 error until 0 errors; with concept_map.json moved aside the u05 concepts are missing, so for errors that are ONLY 'concept not introduced yet' for tokens the plan gives to u05a/u05b/u05c, restore the map and re-run with it instead, and report those tokens (they get cross-checked when Unit 5 ships).
extra: Campaign callbacks: `for member in party.members:` (the roster loop), the bottom loops of spell-book and mana-bars (Obj 1-2), the hold-the-barrier arithmetic spaced (Obj 3), the chalk wall's shrink revealing that "the decay is accelerating" (range(len) neighbors, Obj 5), a countdown to the burst and Bomb Shell's Velocite watch (while, Obj 6); `break` is a bridge to Unit 7's early return. CONVENTIONS from the Unit 2 walkthrough fixes (read the repo's FORMAT.md): "Start like this" hints go LAST, never hint 1, and the last hint's line must be in the solution (the harness warns on both — leave none); solo items and Quick Check builders use explainer="lean"; Quick Check check messages name the slip and the evidence but never the fix; Quick Check forms set questions_to_pass like Unit 2's QC2. INFINITE LOOPS: before authoring any step where a student's while loop could run forever, read how public/workers/python-worker.js and the harness time a run out, and make sure the wrong_answer for 'no update' fails with a clear, honest message rather than hanging the harness.
